messages.text:
What it is: Morning briefing still generates and sends while the swarm is banked (headless, no-agent composer)
What it solves: BUILD FIRST of this pair (lean-drain active_backlog_max_depth is 1, so this
runs alone before BL-309).
How it works: While the swarm is hibernated (no coordinator), the morning trigger composes and writes the day's briefing headlessly instead of nudging a coordinator, labeled as a parked/lightweight briefing with recent git activity, backlog counts, parked profile, and daemon health
